LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 12.3.1 POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Language Use 12.3.1 Possessive pronouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 12.3.1 Possessive pronouns, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: How do you talk about things that belong to you /other people?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 12.3.1 Possessive pronouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: as learner uses possessive pronouns in communication correctly.

Values:
As a learner takes up roles in groups/pair activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship: Social cohesion as the learner works together with peers in role play activities.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Possessive Pronouns is handled in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities

Suggested Learning Resources

Chart, Class readers, Adapted Course books, Flash cards, Recording devices e.g tablets, mobile phone, Dictionary, Internet, Audio-visual recordings,

Posters, Pictures and Photographs, Extracts from newspapers, magazines.
